evidence: The verified view layout lacks ViewToClipNoAA, consistent with UE4.18. Later engine layouts shift subsequent fields by 0x40.
Written velocity averages 0.4999928, agreeing with the source bias 32767/65535; the scale comes from inspected Common.ush.
D3D12RHI markers and D3D12 interface IDs are present in .rdata; successful native D3D12 execution remains untested.
engine.notes: AC7 is a custom branch. Use only capture-validated offsets. A 4096-byte buffer allocation can reflect pooling and does not establish the underlying structure size.

executable_protection.evidence: Shipped .text entropy is about 7.997 across 38.9 MB, the entry point is in .bind, and graphics-import references are absent. The decrypted runtime dump contains readable code and 19,888 import references. .rdata and .pdata provide plaintext data.
executable_protection.consequence: Use the decrypted runtime image for code analysis; the shipped file still supplies fingerprint, imports, strings, and data.

velocity.encoding_detail: stored = velocity * 0.2495 + 32767/65535. Test raw zero before decoding; decoded zero is valid motion.
velocity.camera_motion_evidence: 83.6% of a camera-panning capture is zero; sky pixels remain unwritten during camera movement. This establishes missing dense camera coverage, not the camera contribution within written object vectors.
velocity.notes: Ten draws write the sampled velocity pass. Captured temporal-filter candidates bind this texture; exact consumer shader identity/use remains to be verified. The earlier claim that the game never consumes it was unsupported.

jitter.detail: The research proxy bypasses six bytes at RVA 0x112b1f3 so engine temporal jitter setup runs despite the menu AA selection.
jitter.verified: Sampled perspective views changed from zero jitter before the patch to sub-pixel jitter afterward; recorded horizontal offsets include -0.147, +0.065, and -0.430 pixels.
jitter.field_layout: current x, current y, previous x, previous y, in clip space

temporal_pass.detail: Captured bindings include colour, history, velocity, depth, and a 1x1 exposure candidate while view jitter is zero. This supports temporal filtering; the exact AC7 shader/function is not established by those bindings alone.
temporal_pass.notes: Do not label this definitively as stock FRCPassPostProcessTemporalAA or disable cloud-specific history without inspecting its consumers.

render_scale.detail: At 50%, scene allocations measure 1024x576 while presentation remains 2048x1152. Use engine size/rectangle setup rather than resizing textures alone.
render_scale.resets_detail: Mission loading restores the game scale; the proxy currently reapplies the requested scale on a timer.

per_context.detail: AC7 keeps its own per-context table, FGraphicsSettingsManager: FUN_1405f5260 loads six values through FUN_1405f4590(this, x, index 0..5, flag) matching EGraphicsScreenPercentageSettings (Gameplay 0, NonGameplay 1, VRNonGameplay 2, VRGameplay 3, VRAirShow 4, MPGameplay 5); FName globals DAT_14356eec0..ef18; FUN_14015fb40 references r.ScreenPercentage at 0x14265cbd8. This is what overwrites the console value on transitions. The representation plan applies the render scale here (M3), expected-byte guarded, with the console write as the announced fallback.

insertion_point.recognised_at: the pass that binds colour, depth and velocity together at render resolution
insertion_point.detail: The qualifying set precedes about 27 later sky/cloud/translucency draws into the same colour target. Early evaluation omitted the sky; Present-time evaluation produced the complete diagnostic scene. Revalidate input overwrite boundaries before changing timing.
insertion_point.notes: At reduced scale the HUD composite also shrinks. Reinsert before that composite and coordinate downstream output dimensions, grading, and HUD rendering.

composed_colour.detail: A persistent PS-input watch selects a same-frame full-size R11G11B10_FLOAT recombine-shaped output reading the identified colour and an RGBA16F layer. Missing matches fall back to the original colour. Byte-format fullscreen consumers close discovery. Briefing relief presence in the selected input was reported game-tested on 7 September. Reconstruction quality, resource lifetime through evaluation, and actual shader identity remain unverified.

translucent_depth.detail: Immediately replay separate-layer geometry into preallocated reversed-Z depth seeded from opaque scene depth. Select it only when this frame selects composed colour reading the exact replayed layer with the same context and source depth. No composition keeps original depth. Startup full/half output extents only; unsupported draws or ambiguous layers fall back. Game-tested 7 September in the briefing: 733,861 of 744,726 candidate draws replayed. Flight regression remains unverified.

separate_translucency_resolution.detail: The layer's scale is a four byte immediate inside a patched instruction at RVA 0x10be330, four byte aligned so it can be rewritten while the game runs. Settings name a percentage of the presented resolution and the multiplier is derived from the render scale in effect, so it follows a quality level rather than being fixed. A frame is heavy when its layer receives more indices than a threshold, which is the briefing. Above 1.0 needs the engine to size the layer's depth to match, which four one byte patches enable by narrowing `Scale < 1.f` to `Scale == 1.f` at RVAs 0x1168f6f, 0x1097a0c, 0x109d03a and 0x109d061. Those four are no-ops for every scale the engine produces on its own. Game-tested 7 September: the briefing relief drew at 2048x1152 inside a 1024x576 scene with a matching depth. Flight, other heavy screens and the mission replay are unverified.

current_policy.detail: Default target is 100% of output independently of applied scene percentage; existing allocation/depth patches are reused. Engine pool alignment still requires runtime verification. Default unjittered VS/PS layer is recombined after scene SR without the second DLSS feature. The earlier 1:1 integration remains an explicit comparison mode. The user accepted the unjittered half-output briefing and requested the full-output target for sharper detail. The 100% trial brought terrain jitter back. Source comparison and a failing corrected fixture identified a pixel-to-world unjitter row error; the correction passes Windows synthetic tests, with visual retest pending. Two-frame captures proved native layer draws still used scene-sized views. Seven extra scale-consumer gates correct view/depth selection, verified by a second capture; the user still saw shimmer. Terrain is a 12-control-point patch, so the unjitter override now also covers HS/DS/GS. All-stage pixel/state tests pass; game visual validation is pending. Final capture verifies zero-jitter twins in terrain HS b2 and DS b0 as well as VS/PS. The user confirmed the full-output briefing result and declared the AC7 upscaler finished. Temporary capture disabled.

overlay.detail: The observer-selected device differed from the device presenting to the game window. The old host reproduced a CreateRenderTargetView access violation with two devices and RenderDoc. The patched host selects the swap-chain device and passes egui pixel readback and resize checks under Wine/DXVK/RenderDoc without a backend.

ui.detail: The front-end interface is rasterized at a fixed 1920x1080 through Nimbus.WidgetToTextureConverter (DrawSize at +0x28; UWidgetToTextureConverter_Setup 0x1404d5c10; front-end caller 0x1406243e0 with constants 0x1425f1cac = 1920.0f and 0x1425f1ce4 = 1080.0f). On the briefing it is drawn as four world-space widget quads (6 indices each, reading 1920x1080 B8G8R8A8_TYPELESS widget textures in slot 0 and scene-sized blur and glow surfaces in slots 1, 2, 5 and 6) into AC7's own render-resolution R8G8B8A8_TYPELESS layer, alternating 0x308F6550 / 0x308F6190, with the scene's depth view bound, and composited by the game before the upscale. Extraction of those quads into a mod-owned layer was run five times on 7 September: the interface arrives at native resolution and the frame comes out flat and discoloured, because the quads are composites the engine keeps processing (its own UI composite, glow, grade) and compositing at present skips all of it. The route since 26 September promotes the layers the classifier sees quads drawn into, plus the composite and the eight-bit intermediate between the tonemap and the UI composite, so the quads rasterize at output resolution with their viewport scaled and the game composites them itself; the scene's depth is dropped at that binding (overlay semantics). Built and synthetic-tested with MSVC on Windows; not game-tested.

widget_component_additions.note: No Space field in the dumped UWidgetComponent; the world-space premise is stock-source until M1 classifies per screen.

ui.engine_composite_path: r.HDR.UI.CompositeMode strings at 0x142bc44c8, 0x142bc5140, 0x142cce798; FCompositePS0/1 at 0x142bc7d58 / 0x142bc7e28; FSlateElementVS at 0x142bc5320; FUN_141343660 is FSlateRHIRenderer::DrawWindow_RenderThread. Recorded, not used.

video.detail: AUIManagerActor holds FullscreenMovieWidget at 0x0D60 and a CriWare UManaComponent at 0x0F10; UManaComponent::Play/Stop/IsPlaying, EManaComponentStatus::Playing = 5. The plan's screen policy reports VIDEO from hooks on Play/Stop once located in Ghidra; until then video is never reported and the eligibility fallbacks stay named.

presentation.detail: No frame generation SDK runs on D3D11 (DLSS-G manifest rhi d3d12/vk; FidelityFX FG and XeFG are D3D12-only). The representation plan's bridge keeps a D3D11 IDXGISwapChain4 facade for the game while a same-adapter D3D12 queue owns the real chain; the FG vendor creates or wraps it. Back buffer R10G10B10A2_UNORM 2048x1152; the UI layer must be its own R8G8B8A8_UNORM.

result.detail: Recorded 7 September mission: 7917 evaluations, no refusals, 1024x576 input, 2048x1152 output. The reported image included the complete scene without obvious smearing. Controlled motion, quality, and performance validation remain open.
not_yet: Reinserted into game post-processing with the interface intact. F6 promotes the composite and runs game-tested; the interface stays soft because it is scene geometry on the screens that matter, which the representation plan extracts instead of promoting. F7 is a rough-tonemapped debug display over the back buffer and hides the HUD.

The judgement of the promoted picture. The first Windows game run happened on 26 September after four measured obstacles (docs/research/windows-present-hook-coexistence.md, docs/research/d3d11-runtime-vtable-rewrite.md): Streamline 2.14.1 loads, DLSS evaluates every frame at 800x450 to 1600x900, and F6 promotion ran for over 13,000 frames with the composite, one chain target and two interface layers. Whether the front end is sharp and the shimmer gone has not been written down.

consumer_session.detail: Automatic DLSS start after patch/device readiness; reinsertion after fresh evaluation. Insert is the only hotkey. Overlay exposes Enable DLSS and presets, persisted per user. Preset changes update scene scale from its last applied value, reset history and rebuild reinsertion. Disable restores 100% scene scale and closes jitter. The user accepted the completed AC7 upscaling path on 29 September; full-output briefing stage data was captured. This does not change public plugin lifecycle or FG validation status.
